scope: Corollary 1.2 (Zero mean dimension and crossed-product regularity) of the manuscript “Radius of comparison equals half the mean dimension” (preprints/Radius-of-comparison-equals-half-the-mean-dimension-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 302 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1097583ea21e73e4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h be a minimal homeomorphism of an infinite compact metrizable space X, and put A = C(X) ⋊h Z. The following conditions are equivalent: (i) mdim(X, h) = 0; (ii) (X, h) has the small boundary property; (iii) A ∼ = A ⊗ Z; (iv) dimnuc(A) < ∞; (v) dimnuc(A) ≤ 1. In particular, if mdim(X, h) ∈ (0, ∞], then A ̸∼ = A ⊗ Z and dimnuc(A) = ∞.
